accepted.A3: Checked: the runner folds every whitespace run, U+202F included, to one space before it compares text, and expectNoOverflow reads horizontal overflow only. Every A3 variant passed 10/10, a3-1 and a3-16 among them (toLocaleTimeString lowercased with no whitespace step).
accepted.A4: The remaining gaps are sampling choices. The spec sets borders and radii with shorthands, so the checks read one side and one corner; sideways overflow is read at the breakpoint edges (900 and 899 px) and at 375 px; times are covered under A5. The reviewer's filter, row and selection variants each fail a check.
accepted.A5: EVENTS and TIME_ZONE are given and the runner cannot vary them. The four events cover EDT, EST, the 12 am hour and a day boundary, so a fixed offset fails; a lookup table or a month rule is plain to see in review.
accepted.B1: Both Sonnet solvers passed 10/10. Haiku wrote 9:05 AM, while the page asks for h:mm am in lower case.
accepted.B2: The winter sentence lets a solver verify the expected times and names no API; the button note says which defaults the spec's tokens replace. Neither gives the code.
accepted.B4: Sideways scrolling is read at 900, 899 and 375 px, the breakpoint edges and the phone width, and the item's E2 run also checked 320 px; a check at every width is not possible.
